patterns.note: Massive display typography layered directly behind realistic, skeuomorphic hardware mockups to create depth.
High-contrast pairing of elegant, high-contrast serif headings with technical, small monospace metadata.
Deep dark mode starting with pure black, transitioning into a rich teal gradient in the lower sections.
Scroll-driven parallax where the massive background brand text drifts slower than the foreground hardware mockups.

technique_notes: Layer massive, low-contrast serif text in the background and place a detailed skeuomorphic device mockup in the foreground. Use GSAP ScrollTrigger to apply a subtle parallax drift between the two layers.
Create dark, semi-transparent feature cards with thin, low-contrast borders and subtle inner glows to maintain a premium, tactile aesthetic.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized elegant serif headings (~6x body) paired with tiny, wide-spaced monospace labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on cards and mockups, contrasting with sharp layout lines.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and editorial, with generous vertical breathing room and overlapping elements.

standout: The juxtaposition of massive, elegant editorial serif typography with highly detailed, retro-futuristic skeuomorphic hardware mockups that parallax on scroll.
